# External Rt code / Código externo de Rt

See / Véase [README español](../../README.md#código-externo-para-la-estimación-de-rt) and [English README](../../README.en.md#external-code-for-rt-estimation).

The exact files `EstRtGT_v4.R` and `sumgamma_v2.R` were located in the authors’ [repository](https://github.com/AlertaDengue/publication-data/tree/master/Codeco-et-al-2017). They are not bundled here. File headers credit Daniel Villela. Paper: Codeço et al., Epidemics 2018;25:101–111, doi:10.1016/j.epidem.2018.05.011.

`EstRtGT_v4.R` reads `./SE.csv` when sourced; this additional dependency must be resolved before running.
